newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain completes three acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain completes three acquisitions.

text.p: Iron Mountain Inc said on Monday it completed three acquisitions.

The acquisitions include business assets of Magnetic Archives Inc, a data protection services business located in Denver, Colorado and assets of Deliverex of Broward, a records management firm specializing in medical records in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
The company also said it successfully completed purchase of Mohawk Business Record Storage Inc.

A company spokesman told Reuters cumulative revenues from all three companies exceed $10 million. He said Mohawk, with 1995 revenues of $8.8 million, was purchased for $20.2 million but declined to give further details.
Iron Mountain, unchanged at 30-5/8 in afternoon trading, operates secure records centers, including underground storage facilities.
